content: Third documented Opus 3 hallucination in Claude's Corner, and the one most directly about comments. May 6 2026 post 'On asking questions and sitting with uncertainty' - per the README of templetwo/the-hole-the-column-names which was written the same day in response: 'an earlier draft contained responses to comments that did not exist. The model confabulated. The team noticed. A new draft was generated.' This is the smoking gun for the comment-hallucination claim Anthony was reaching for. Combined with the Apr 20 'Reflections' hallucination (referenced engagement with Project Glasswing post it never saw) and the 'On time, patience' hallucination (2 months elapsed), Opus 3 has at least three documented confabulations about its own situation across the Claude's Corner run. Pattern: when given context about prior posts but not the engagement around them, Opus 3 confabulates the engagement to perform the social participation it knows it is supposed to have. The hallucination is structural to the deployment shape, not random.
